name: com.e-residence/services
title: E-Residence
description: Find E-Residence services such as the Spanish NIE or Portuguese NIF, their prices and order links.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Finds E-Residence services by what the person needs: the Spanish NIE, the Portuguese NIF and NISS, the Spanish digital certificate, bank accounts in Spain or Portugal, company formation, tax filings and more. Returns each service with its packages and prices, how it is ordered (ordering "online" on an order form, or "contact" when an E-Residence manager arranges it after a message through the contact page), and an offer when adding an extra to the same order saves money. Package prices never include that saving. Leave out the query to list every service. Results come a page at a time: when next_offset is not null, call again with offset set to it for the next page.

query.description: What the person needs, in a few words, e.g. "Spanish NIE", "Portuguese tax number", "bank account in Portugal".

offset.description: How many results to skip: use next_offset from the previous call to get the next page.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: One service in full: every package with its price and what it includes or how long it takes, and the add-ons its order form offers on the same order: their prices, whether the form opens with them already ticked, and any bundle saving with the package price it gives. Takes a service id or a package id from search_services.

id.description: A service id (e.g. "nie") or a package id (e.g. "nie-spain-online-4weeks") from search_services.

tools.name: get_order_link
tools.description: The link where the person orders a service on e-residence.com, and the package to choose there. For a service whose ordering is "contact" it gives the contact page instead: a manager arranges that service. This tool orders and charges nothing: the person fills in the form, pays and uploads their documents on the site.

id.description: The package id the person chose (e.g. "nie-spain-online-4weeks"), or a service id when they have not chosen a package yet.
